quotes.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves have a real chance of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: I think the Timberwolves have a real authentic chance of winning a championship.
quotes.quote: I think the Timberwolves have a real authentic chance of winning a championship. This gives me early 2000s Portland vibes where they definitely have the pieces to do whatever they need to do, whatever they want to do post-season. Will they be there? I don't know. Will they be active and ready to go? I don't know. Will they not get in trouble? I don't know. But everybody is going to want to see them play and they are going to be exciting.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat and Raptors will be the last teams standing in the East
quotes.excerpt: I think Miami and Toronto are going to be the last things standing on the East.
quotes.quote: I think Miami and Toronto are going to be the last things standing on the East. Something brewing in Toronto and Giannis is just capable of leading a team so far before he needs any help. The engine that Giannis has, it goes so far. You don't know when he is going to need his pieces to come in.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard is exactly what the Clippers need for a deep playoff run
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi is exactly what they needed. The whole playoffs we watched them it was just he's what they need.
quotes.quote: Watching Kawhi, he is exactly what they needed. The whole playoffs we watched them it was just he's what they need, so I look for them to go deep. And if I can't see, I'm going to say Toronto and Minnesota is going to be the championship.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves must win if they reach the conference finals
quotes.excerpt: If they get as far as we think they should, which is finals, semi-finals, they better win.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: If they get as far as we think they should, which is finals, semi-finals, they better win. The only person they got to worry about, they better worry about Dillon Brooks and Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I just wanted to throw a wild take out there. I ain't going to lie, I love watching the Timberwolves. I just wanted to throw a wild take out there, but I ain't going to act like professional winning don't exist in OKC.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball brings the recklessness that gets the team over the hump
quotes.excerpt: He brings the recklessness that gets us over the hump.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I think that's what LaMelo is there for. He brings the recklessness that gets us over the hump.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: No doubt that's what he's there for.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert needs to adjust to team culture
quotes.excerpt: Rudy wasn't there. He might not be American enough.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I didn't think about that up until we just saw them all together. Rudy wasn't there. He might not be American enough. Rudy, we need you to wear a durag for a couple weeks.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: No, no, no, not to playoffs. Rudy, don't become one of them. He should have just been back there in his beret. He should have just been back there like with a little beret, a little striped shirt.
